_help: Every entry here shows up in the DEV level's NPC spawner. To add an NPC: drop a .glb (skinned or not, Y up, facing +Z, metres) into assets/npcs/ and add a line below. 'clip' = animation clip to loop (default: the first one), 'scale' = uniform scale, 'radius'/'height'/'hp' = hit capsule, 'yaw' = extra turn in degrees if the model faces another way.
